com.justin.pcbmaker.name: PCB Maker
com.justin.pcbmaker.notes: PCB Maker 2.1.3: DRC-clean autorouter - traces of different nets never cross and always keep the clearance gap (same-net traces may connect); uses a two-via detour to get past a blocking trace. Tap a trace to Rip Up, Redraw by hand (other nets blocked) or Reroute just that net. New Clearance (mil) setting. DRC now checks trace/pad/via clearance and same-layer crossings. Layer colors unchanged (red top, green bottom, yellow middle). TO-220-5 footprint corrected to staggered leads.

com.justin.plasmacadcam.name: Plasma CAD CAM
com.justin.plasmacadcam.notes: New 3D view: tap 3D to see the part at material thickness and rotate it about X/Y/Z (drag, pinch, ±15° buttons, Top/Front/Right/Iso presets, XYZ axis marker, optional cut paths). Display only — G-code, DXF and SVG output unchanged.
